players.product: AI-accelerated modeling and simulation software for drug development

quarterly_data.signal: Third quarter fiscal 2026 (ended May 31, 2026) results: total revenue increased 7% to $21.9 million; software revenue was flat at $12.6 million (58% of revenue) while services revenue increased 20% to $9.3 million (42%); gross margin was 69% versus 64%; adjusted EBITDA was $7.9 million (36% of revenue) versus $7.4 million (37%); adjusted diluted EPS $0.30 versus $0.45. Nine-month revenue rose 5% to $64.6 million. CEO Shawn O'Connor: 'We delivered solid third quarter results, with revenue increasing 7%, highlighted by strength in our services revenue, which grew 20%, while software revenue was flat year over year.'
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 FY2026 revenue $21.9 million (+7%); software $12.6 million (flat); services $9.3 million (+20%); gross margin 69% (64%); adjusted EBITDA $7.9 million (36%)

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 FY2026 investor presentation: overall services revenue grew 20% for 3Q26 and 10% for the trailing twelve months, with total services backlog of $23.3M.

Q3 FY2026 investor presentation, software: overall software revenue was flat for 3Q26 and -3% for the trailing twelve months, with renewal rates impacted by client consolidations and site closures. Third-quarter software highlights: GastroPlus added 12 new clients and 6 upsells to existing clients, ADMET Predictor 9 new clients and 9 upsells, and MonolixSuite 11 new clients and 7 upsells.
quarterly_data.figure: GastroPlus 12 new clients / 6 upsells; ADMET Predictor 9 / 9; MonolixSuite 11 / 7
